name: Plugin Manager
author: Gavin Nugent
description: On/off switches for installed shell plugins, and removal for third-party ones: your plugins up top, optional first-party bar widgets in a twirl-down below, alphabetical within each. The list scrolls when it overflows. Core shell plugins are hidden. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle nosignal.plugin-manager

barWidget.description: Bar icon that toggles the plugin-manager panel
